summary: Unidentified male snowmobiler in his 40s knocked unconscious, apparently after hitting a compression, about 30 miles out near Schofield Park; regained consciousness, self-extricated and drove himself to the trailhead while Crested Butte SAR followed him back; team staged just before Emerald Lake where a wet slide was occurring as they arrived, then sent a two-member team to meet the snowmobilers and assist them out
notes: Date = the Monday before the April 6, 2016 article (weekday-verified); details of the crash unclear, unknown whether he sought medical attention
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gunnison County, Colorado, United States)
